name: Tai Souta
source:
The twin brother of Motoko, Kaoru's best friend. He's in the school's art club. He's refreshingly handsome and has a good personality, making him popular.

He doesn't seem interested in romance, probably because he's a serious siscon.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
